# amux Configuration Reference

[English](configuration.md) | [简体中文](configuration.zh-CN.md)

This reference covers the settings read by amux from `~/.amux/config.toml`. Common metadata lives in the public core's `internal/config/reference.go`; distributions register their own metadata through extensions. Update the owning module's metadata when changing keys, defaults, or constraints, then run `make config-doc` in that module. `scripts/check.sh` checks for omissions and stale generated files.

Common commands:

```bash
amux system config path
amux system config get <key>
amux system config set <key> <value>
amux system config unset <key>
```

“CLI-managed” specifically means the generic `amux system config set/get/unset` commands. Keys marked “No” may have dedicated commands listed in their descriptions; otherwise edit TOML directly. Replace `<profile>` with the actual Feishu Bot Profile name. `<provider>` supports only `codex`. This reference does not include example sensitive values.

## Web management console

| Configuration key | Type | Default | Constraints | CLI-managed | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `console.port` | integer | 7892 | 1–65535 | Yes | Installation-wide temporary Web console port shared by all Bots. The owner enables all-interface IPv4 listening from private /amux; it closes after 30 minutes by default. |
| `console.public_url` | URL | Empty (use Hub host IP and port) | bare HTTP(S) origin; no credentials/query/fragment | Yes | Console origin shown in the private management card, used only while temporarily enabled. Empty selects the host IP. HTTP is for trusted networks; use HTTPS for public access. |

## Runtime cleanup

| Configuration key | Type | Default | Constraints | CLI-managed | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `maintenance.daily_cleanup.enabled` | boolean | true | — | Yes | Automatically clean up ordinary and user-isolated topic data daily and privately report results to Bot owners. Installation-wide switch; applies immediately. |
| `maintenance.daily_cleanup.at` | string | 06:17 | HH:MM | Yes | Daily cleanup time in the Hub local timezone; a missed run is performed once when the system resumes. |
| `maintenance.daily_cleanup.protected_paths` | string array | [] | absolute paths | Yes | Absolute paths of shared or long-lived workspaces always retained by daily cleanup, across all Runtimes. |
| `runtime.task_cleanup.enabled` | boolean | true | — | No | Whether to clean up terminal task history automatically. |
| `runtime.task_cleanup.terminal_history_ttl_seconds` | integer seconds | 604800 (7 days) | >0 | No | Retention period for terminal task history. |
| `runtime.task_cleanup.sweep_interval_seconds` | integer seconds | 3600 | >0 | No | Sweep interval for terminal task cleanup. |
| `runtime.broker_reap.enabled` | boolean | true | — | No | Whether to periodically reap orphaned Session broker processes and their files (deleted or stopped Sessions, or duplicate brokers). |
| `runtime.broker_reap.sweep_interval_seconds` | integer seconds | 300 | >0 | No | Sweep interval for orphaned broker reaping. |

## Experimental Feishu features

| Configuration key | Type | Default | Constraints | CLI-managed | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bridge.feishu.group_settings.enabled` | boolean | false | — | Yes | Installation-wide group settings experiment. When disabled, saved group settings and Sessions are retained and independently configured groups pause new work; unconfigured groups and private chats use Bot defaults. Restart to apply changes. |
| `bridge.feishu.presentation.completion_notification_enabled` | boolean | false | — | Yes | Installation-wide experiment switch for long-session completion notifications, affecting every assistant. When disabled, no new success, input-needed, or failure notifications are sent. Restart after changing it. |
| `bridge.feishu.experimental.steer_foreground` | boolean | false | — | Yes | Experiment switch for foreground coordination and busy-input steering. When enabled, follow-ups from the same sender while a turn runs are injected into that turn instead of interrupting it, and singleton and thread chats receive the foreground/background coordination prompt (first submit and every 20). When disabled, busy input interrupts and resubmits as before. AMUX_FEISHU_BUSY_INPUT=interrupt forces steering off. Restart after changing it. |
| `bridge.feishu.experimental.show_background_tasks` | boolean | false | — | Yes | Background task progress card experiment: when on, each background task (subtask / background agent instance) started from a Feishu chat gets its own live progress card; off by default, background work posts no cards and the foreground agent reports results. Toggle on the Feishu experiments card; applies immediately on save. |
| `bridge.feishu.experimental.mention_turn_initiator` | boolean | false | — | Yes | Group-topic reply mention experiment: when enabled, the first Agent reply delivery mentions each distinct human user whose input triggered that Turn. Private chats, Bot singleton output, group watch, App/Bot input, and Turns without a human sender are excluded. This changes Feishu presentation only, not raw Agent output or conversation context; applies immediately on save. |
| `memory.enabled` | boolean | false | — | Yes | Agent memory experiment switch, controlled by the Hub for all Runtimes without an Agent Profile; shared globally without isolation and scoped to the effective Principal with user isolation. Disabling blocks reads and writes while retaining files and native-memory suppression in existing conversations. Restart to apply. |

## State outside config.toml

Feishu App Secrets and legacy-host credentials live in `$AMUX_HOME/secrets/`; identified Agent credentials are stored per Principal in `$AMUX_HOME/principals/<principal-id>/secrets/`. Runtime state such as workspace Session quotas, thread bindings, and group watch bindings lives in Bridge/Runtime SQLite databases. These are not `config.toml` keys and must not be written to that file.
